Unique_Explanation_Function: Acts as an antifoaming agent by reducing unwanted foam during processing.
Potential_Advantages: Can help production run smoothly and control foaming.
Potential_Disadvantages_or_Consideration: No direct nutritional benefit; use must be limited to permitted applications.
FSSAI_Limit_or_Quantity_Guidance: Permitted foods and maximum/use conditions are category-specific under FSSAI Appendix A.
FSSAI_Source: FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 (as amended), especially Appendix A and relevant product-category chapter; https://fssai.gov.in/food-law/regulations/compendium/food-products-standards

Unique_Explanation_Function: Can help bind water and improve texture or stability in permitted foods.
Potential_Advantages: May support processing consistency and moisture retention.
Potential_Disadvantages_or_Consideration: Contributes phosphate; people advised to limit phosphate for medical reasons should follow professional advice.
FSSAI_Limit_or_Quantity_Guidance: Permitted foods and maximum/use conditions are category-specific under FSSAI Appendix A.
FSSAI_Source: FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 (as amended), especially Appendix A and relevant product-category chapter; https://fssai.gov.in/food-law/regulations/compendium/food-products-standards

Unique_Explanation_Function: Can function as an acidity regulator, raising agent component or mineral source depending on use.
Potential_Advantages: Supports leavening or formulation stability in permitted products.
Potential_Disadvantages_or_Consideration: Adds calcium/phosphate; technological use does not guarantee meaningful nutritional contribution.
FSSAI_Limit_or_Quantity_Guidance: Permitted foods and maximum/use conditions are category-specific under FSSAI Appendix A.
FSSAI_Source: FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 (as amended), especially Appendix A and relevant product-category chapter; https://fssai.gov.in/food-law/regulations/compendium/food-products-standards

Unique_Explanation_Function: May act as a colour/firming or acidity-related ingredient and can also be used as a calcium source.
Potential_Advantages: Can serve a technical function and, in some products, contribute calcium.
Potential_Disadvantages_or_Consideration: Excess calcium intake can be inappropriate for some people; role depends on product formulation.
FSSAI_Limit_or_Quantity_Guidance: Permitted uses and limits depend on food category; verify FSSAI Appendix A and relevant standards.
FSSAI_Source: FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 (as amended), especially Appendix A and relevant product-category chapter; https://fssai.gov.in/food-law/regulations/compendium/food-products-standards

Unique_Explanation_Function: Can regulate acidity or support processing functionality.
Potential_Advantages: Helps maintain product consistency where permitted.
Potential_Disadvantages_or_Consideration: Adds sodium and phosphate; may matter for people on restricted-sodium/phosphate diets.
FSSAI_Limit_or_Quantity_Guidance: Permitted foods and maximum/use conditions are category-specific under FSSAI Appendix A.
FSSAI_Source: FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 (as amended), especially Appendix A and relevant product-category chapter; https://fssai.gov.in/food-law/regulations/compendium/food-products-standards

Unique_Explanation_Function: Adds sweetness, bulk and can contribute to browning and texture.
Potential_Advantages: Improves taste and can help baked products develop colour and structure.
Potential_Disadvantages_or_Consideration: Frequent high intake contributes to excess calories and increases risk of tooth decay; high free-sugar intake is linked to health risks.
FSSAI_Limit_or_Quantity_Guidance: No universal FSSAI maximum for sugar as a general ingredient across all foods; product standards and nutrition/labelling rules apply.
FSSAI_Source: FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 (as amended), especially Appendix A and relevant product-category chapter; https://fssai.gov.in/food-law/regulations/compendium/food-products-standards

Unique_Explanation_Function: Provides sweetness and helps retain moisture; may reduce sugar crystallisation.
Potential_Advantages: Can keep some products softer and smoother.
Potential_Disadvantages_or_Consideration: Adds sugars and calories just like other caloric sweeteners.
FSSAI_Limit_or_Quantity_Guidance: No universal FSSAI maximum across all foods; applicable product standards and labelling rules apply.
FSSAI_Source: FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 (as amended), especially Appendix A and relevant product-category chapter; https://fssai.gov.in/food-law/regulations/compendium/food-products-standards

Unique_Explanation_Function: Adds sweetness and body; can control crystallisation and affect chewiness.
Potential_Advantages: Useful for texture and processing stability.
Potential_Disadvantages_or_Consideration: Adds sugars/calories and can contribute to high overall sugar intake.
FSSAI_Limit_or_Quantity_Guidance: No universal FSSAI maximum across all foods; applicable product standards and labelling rules apply.
FSSAI_Source: FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 (as amended), especially Appendix A and relevant product-category chapter; https://fssai.gov.in/food-law/regulations/compendium/food-products-standards

Unique_Explanation_Function: Provides sweetness and can support browning or fermentation.
Potential_Advantages: Useful in formulation and provides readily available carbohydrate.
Potential_Disadvantages_or_Consideration: Adds sugar and calories; excess intake contributes to high free-sugar intake.
FSSAI_Limit_or_Quantity_Guidance: No universal FSSAI maximum across all foods; applicable product standards and labelling rules apply.
FSSAI_Source: FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 (as amended), especially Appendix A and relevant product-category chapter; https://fssai.gov.in/food-law/regulations/compendium/food-products-standards

Unique_Explanation_Function: Sweetens and adds characteristic flavour; also affects moisture and browning.
Potential_Advantages: Provides flavour and can replace some refined sugar in a recipe.
Potential_Disadvantages_or_Consideration: Still a source of free sugars; not recommended for infants under 12 months.
FSSAI_Limit_or_Quantity_Guidance: No universal FSSAI maximum across all foods; honey identity/quality standards and labelling rules apply.
FSSAI_Source: FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 (as amended), especially Appendix A and relevant product-category chapter; https://fssai.gov.in/food-law/regulations/compendium/food-products-standards

Unique_Explanation_Function: Adds sweetness, colour and a caramel-like flavour.
Potential_Advantages: Provides a distinctive taste and small amounts of minerals depending on processing.
Potential_Disadvantages_or_Consideration: Still a concentrated sugar source; not automatically healthier than sugar for blood-glucose or calorie management.
FSSAI_Limit_or_Quantity_Guidance: No universal FSSAI maximum across all foods; applicable standards and labelling rules apply.
FSSAI_Source: FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 (as amended), especially Appendix A and relevant product-category chapter; https://fssai.gov.in/food-law/regulations/compendium/food-products-standards

Unique_Explanation_Function: Provides sweetness with very little energy compared with sugar.
Potential_Advantages: Can reduce the amount of sugar needed in some products.
Potential_Disadvantages_or_Consideration: May leave a lingering aftertaste; permitted foods and limits are restricted.
FSSAI_Limit_or_Quantity_Guidance: Maximum levels and permitted food categories are specified by FSSAI; check the exact Appendix A entry and conditions.
FSSAI_Source: FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 (as amended), especially Appendix A and relevant product-category chapter; https://fssai.gov.in/food-law/regulations/compendium/food-products-standards

Unique_Explanation_Function: Provide or restore flavour associated with a natural source.
Potential_Advantages: Can give a recognisable product aroma and taste.
Potential_Disadvantages_or_Consideration: The word “natural” does not mean allergen-free or nutritionally beneficial; source details may matter.
FSSAI_Limit_or_Quantity_Guidance: Use and labelling must comply with FSSAI flavouring-agent rules; a universal quantity limit cannot be stated for all flavourings.
FSSAI_Source: FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 (as amended), especially Appendix A and relevant product-category chapter; https://fssai.gov.in/food-law/regulations/compendium/food-products-standards

Unique_Explanation_Function: Provide flavour molecules matching those found in nature, produced by permitted processes.
Potential_Advantages: Can give consistent flavour from batch to batch.
Potential_Disadvantages_or_Consideration: Primarily a sensory ingredient; no nutritional benefit should be assumed.
FSSAI_Limit_or_Quantity_Guidance: Use and labelling must comply with FSSAI flavouring-agent rules; limits depend on substance and application.
FSSAI_Source: FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 (as amended), especially Appendix A and relevant product-category chapter; https://fssai.gov.in/food-law/regulations/compendium/food-products-standards

Unique_Explanation_Function: Create or strengthen a chosen flavour profile.
Potential_Advantages: Can deliver consistent taste and aroma.
Potential_Disadvantages_or_Consideration: No nutritional benefit; people may prefer simpler ingredient lists, and declarations must be accurate.
FSSAI_Limit_or_Quantity_Guidance: Use and labelling must comply with FSSAI flavouring-agent rules; specific limits depend on substance and application.
FSSAI_Source: FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 (as amended), especially Appendix A and relevant product-category chapter; https://fssai.gov.in/food-law/regulations/compendium/food-products-standards

Unique_Explanation_Function: Provides fat, carries fat-soluble flavours and can contribute crispness or texture.
Potential_Advantages: Stable for many food-processing applications and contributes texture.
Potential_Disadvantages_or_Consideration: Often high in saturated fat compared with some liquid vegetable oils; overall diet and quantity matter.
FSSAI_Limit_or_Quantity_Guidance: No single universal maximum as a general ingredient; edible-oil standards, composition requirements and product-specific rules apply.
FSSAI_Source: FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 (as amended), especially Appendix A and relevant product-category chapter; https://fssai.gov.in/food-law/regulations/compendium/food-products-standards

Unique_Explanation_Function: Thickens when heated with water and contributes body or structure.
Potential_Advantages: Useful for texture and binding in many foods.
Potential_Disadvantages_or_Consideration: Primarily carbohydrate and may raise the energy content without adding much protein or fibre.
FSSAI_Limit_or_Quantity_Guidance: No universal maximum as an ingredient across all foods; product standards and additive rules for modified starches apply.
FSSAI_Source: FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 (as amended), especially Appendix A and relevant product-category chapter; https://fssai.gov.in/food-law/regulations/compendium/food-products-standards

Unique_Explanation_Function: A broad label term that may refer to ingredients used to improve dough handling, strength or baked volume.
Potential_Advantages: Can make processing and product texture more consistent.
Potential_Disadvantages_or_Consideration: The exact function and safety limit cannot be evaluated without the specific substance being identified.
FSSAI_Limit_or_Quantity_Guidance: Cannot assign a specific FSSAI maximum from this generic name; identify the actual additive/INS number and verify its permitted use.
FSSAI_Source: FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 (as amended), especially Appendix A and relevant product-category chapter; https://fssai.gov.in/food-law/regulations/compendium/food-products-standards

Unique_Explanation_Function: May be added for fortification or to restore nutrients lost during processing.
Potential_Advantages: Can increase the content of selected nutrients where used appropriately.
Potential_Disadvantages_or_Consideration: Excess intake of some nutrients can be harmful; presence does not mean the food is generally healthy.
FSSAI_Limit_or_Quantity_Guidance: Levels depend on the specific vitamin/mineral and applicable fortification or product standards; no single limit applies to all.
FSSAI_Source: FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 (as amended), especially Appendix A and relevant product-category chapter; https://fssai.gov.in/food-law/regulations/compendium/food-products-standards

Unique_Explanation_Function: Provides a vanilla-like aroma and taste.
Potential_Advantages: Can create a familiar flavour profile and balance sweetness.
Potential_Disadvantages_or_Consideration: Adds flavour rather than meaningful nutrition; exact source and labelling category matter.
FSSAI_Limit_or_Quantity_Guidance: Use and labelling must comply with FSSAI flavouring-agent rules; no single universal limit applies to all flavour preparations.
FSSAI_Source: FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 (as amended), especially Appendix A and relevant product-category chapter; https://fssai.gov.in/food-law/regulations/compendium/food-products-standards

Ingredient_or_Additive: Other named flavour (e.g., milk, mango, cake)
Unique_Explanation_Function: Adds the declared flavour profile or aroma to the product.
Potential_Advantages: Can improve sensory appeal and make flavour more consistent.
Potential_Disadvantages_or_Consideration: The term alone does not reveal the precise composition or allergen status; check full label details.
FSSAI_Limit_or_Quantity_Guidance: Specific quantity limits depend on the flavouring substance and food category; follow FSSAI flavouring-agent rules.
FSSAI_Source: FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 (as amended), especially Appendix A and relevant product-category chapter; https://fssai.gov.in/food-law/regulations/compendium/food-products-standards

Unique_Explanation_Function: Summarises caloric sugars added to the product; it is not a separate additive.
Potential_Advantages: Helps consumers compare products and monitor sugar intake.
Potential_Disadvantages_or_Consideration: High intake can contribute to excess calories, tooth decay and metabolic health risks.
FSSAI_Limit_or_Quantity_Guidance: FSSAI does not set one universal maximum for added sugar across all packaged foods; product-specific standards and labelling rules apply.
FSSAI_Source: FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 (as amended), especially Appendix A and relevant product-category chapter; https://fssai.gov.in/food-law/regulations/compendium/food-products-standards

Unique_Explanation_Function: Flags palm oil/palmolein when identified in the ingredient list.
Potential_Advantages: Helps users understand the type of fat used in a product.
Potential_Disadvantages_or_Consideration: Palm oil contains saturated fat; health impact depends on overall diet and amount consumed.
FSSAI_Limit_or_Quantity_Guidance: No universal maximum as a category marker; edible-oil standards and product-specific rules apply.
FSSAI_Source: FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 (as amended), especially Appendix A and relevant product-category chapter; https://fssai.gov.in/food-law/regulations/compendium/food-products-standards
